notes.title: God Save the Queen!
notes.content:
[h2]Press Ctrl patch notes - March 18, 2020[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Progress is now saved automatically when entering a new level.
[*] Modified some colliders for a more coherent experience.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a certain Steam Achievement wouldn't trigger properly.
[/list]
